HK Bus ETA is a Hong Kong bus estimated time of arrival app made for Watch OS.

You can check when the next (up to 3) bus will come at a particular stop on a particular route. 
Contains KMB, CityBus, New Lantau Bus, MTR Bus and GMB routes of Hong Kong. 
Also includes MTR Lines and Light Rail Routes.

Simulated tiles can be created displaying ETA times of your favourite routes and stops, maximizing convenience when deciding when to leave for the bus, or even which bus.

You can send bus routes directly from your phone and open them in this app on your watch via share links from supported apps (Currently KMB App, Citybus App & hkbus.app) with the help of the phone companion app. The watch app must be in the foreground while this feature is used.

Data is provided by data.gov.hk and the relevant service operator.
This App is available in Traditional Chinese and English.

This App optionally requires location permission if the "Display any closes stop of the route" function is used, it is for searching the closes stop to you when using Tiles, no location data are stored or sent.
